note: Versioned task suite. Each task has an OBJECTIVE, automatic quality check (fact presence) so token savings can never be won by a worse answer. Inputs are fixed; add tasks over time and bump suite_version. No LLM output is stored here — only the fixed inputs + the check.

tasks.prompt: Answer in one short paragraph: what HTTP status code means 'Not Found', and what does 401 mean? Name both numbers explicitly.
In Python, which method appends a single element to the end of a list, and which one concatenates another list onto it? Name both method names.
List every prime number strictly between 10 and 20. Give just the numbers.
How many minutes are in 2.5 hours, and how many seconds are in one hour? Give both numbers.
